name: researching-plugin
description: Route research tasks into literature discovery, project-local paper records, evidence synthesis, and a domain-neutral human-supervised Task DAG with auditable reports and gates.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate evidence-grounded research with human checkpoints
interface.longDescription: Routes research tasks to focused literature discovery, project-local PDF records, evidence grounding, domain-neutral route comparison, H0-H4 task classification, bounded session-local parallel work, single-writer report reduction, and explicit human checkpoints or handoffs.
defaultPrompt: Use the researching workflow to find papers for my current task.
Find a paper, save its authorized PDF in my research folder, and create a Markdown record.
Turn my rough question into a research brief with feasible routes and a human decision checkpoint.
Build a durable research Task DAG, dispatch only safe independent work, and prepare Human Handoffs for tasks that require my participation.
